ui_bugs.issue: First 4 columns are hard-coded as (required) via `i < 4` check. This marks 'Service Categories' as (required) even though the backend treats it as OPTIONAL (only Production Code, Production Name, Knowledge Domain, Measurement Unit are required). Should mark columns 0,1,2,4 as required instead of 0-3.

integration_issues.issue: Transient console errors on first paint: '[useOrganization] Error: TypeError: Failed to fetch', '[AppLayout] Workspace context error: TypeError: Failed to fetch', 'Error fetching profile: TypeError: Failed to fetch'. action_items: MEDIUM: Fix ImportWizard.jsx TemplateStep required-column marker. 'Service Categories' (column index 3) is marked (required) but is actually optional per backend. Change condition from `i < 4` to `[0,1,2,4].includes(i)` (Production Code, Production Name, Knowledge Domain, Measurement Unit).

OPTIONAL (carry-over from iterations 19-21): Fix transient 'Failed to fetch' race on first paint of /app/* routes (useOrganization + AppLayout workspace-context + Supabase profile). Non-blocking but noisy.
OPTIONAL (carry-over): Split ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx (2201 lines) and production_library.py (1980 lines) - both exceed the 700-line guideline.
OPTIONAL cleanup: This iteration created TEST-WF-<ts>-A/B and TEST-IMP-<ts>-A production items via the commit endpoint. They will accumulate on repeated CI runs; consider a teardown fixture.
critical_code_review_comments: ImportWizard.jsx line 246-259: hard-coded `i < 4` for required marker is fragile — will silently drift if column order changes. Should be a whitelist of required column names.

production_library.py commit endpoint (line ~1369): re-parses CSV a second time (validation already parsed once). Consider caching the validated payload server-side keyed by a token, or accept validated JSON directly, to avoid double-parse and eliminate the risk of validation/commit divergence.

commit endpoint iterates POST /production_items rows one by one via Supabase REST — no batched insert. Slow for larger CSVs; also every insert triggers a separate POST + subsequent POST to production_item_service_categories per category. Consider batch insert.
ImportWizard.jsx handleImport (line 989) posts the CSV file again to /commit even though validation already succeeded. Same file is uploaded twice per import — inefficient but functional.
validate endpoint returns validated_items at top level (~1362) but commit ignores that data and re-derives everything — schema drift risk.
Service Worker 'Controller changed, reloading...' at first paint causes the app to reload, which then triggers the 'Failed to fetch' race. Root cause likely SW cache invalidation on first mount.
